title: A Wolf in Sheep's Pixels: Visual Camouflage Attacks via HDR Gain Maps
abstract: arXiv:2611.25469v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An image can pass automated safety checks while showing harmful content to its human viewer. We introduce DRJanus, a visual camouflage attack that exploits the gap between standard dynamic range (SDR) processing and high dynamic range (HDR) display. Automated systems often read only an image's SDR base, whereas HDR viewers reconstruct its appearance using an auxiliary gain map. DRJanus inverts this reconstruction to embed two independently chosen color images in a single JPEG, without querying or optimizing against the target model. It preserves the chosen SDR base exactly and reconstructs HDR targets at an average PSNR of 43.03 dB across 400 images. On a benchmark of 100 sexual-content images, DRJanus evades detection by all six tested commercial moderation services and nine vision-language models. Across five agents, each evaluated on 120 task cases per threat setting, attack success ranges from 31.67% to 100% for moderation evasion

translated_title: 披着羊皮的像素狼：基于HDR增益图的视觉伪装攻击
translated_abstract: 图像可以通过自动安全检查，同时向人类观看者展示有害内容。我们提出了DRJanus，一种利用标准动态范围（SDR）处理与高动态范围（HDR）显示之间差异的视觉伪装攻击。自动化系统通常只读取图像的SDR基础层，而HDR显示器则使用辅助增益图重建图像外观。DRJanus反转这一重建过程，在单个JPEG文件中嵌入两张独立选择的彩色图像，且无需查询或针对目标模型进行优化。该方法能够精确保留所选的SDR基础图像，并在400张图像上以平均43.03 dB的PSNR重建HDR目标图像。在包含100张色情内容图像的基准测试中，DRJanus成功逃避了所有六种被测试的商业内容审核服务和九种视觉语言模型的检测。在五个智能体上，每种威胁设置下各评估120个任务案例，内容审核逃避的攻击成功率介于31.67%至100%之间。
tldr: DRJanus利用SDR处理与HDR显示之间的差异，通过HDR增益图在单个JPEG文件中嵌入两张不同的图像，使有害内容通过自动安全检测却只向人类观看者显示。
en_tdlr: DRJanus exploits the gap between SDR processing and HDR display by embedding two different images in a single JPEG via HDR gain maps, enabling harmful content to pass automated safety checks while being shown only to human viewers.
